rule: cell k = heading 11.25k (0 down-right on screen, 45 at the viewer), as the painted strip
note: body@2x.png is on the painted body.t2@2x.webp canvas with the pivot on the same pixel; the turret cells (sized to fit every heading) are a little bigger than the painted 53 x 36. Nothing of the body stands in front of the turret, so no front layer.
aim_note: aim_deg: on-screen direction the barrel points (0 = right, 90 = down), measured from the 3D model; muzzle: [dx, dy] game px from the pivot to the muzzle tip on screen; ground_deg: on-screen direction of the cell's heading on the ground; aim_len: barrel length on screen in game px (short = pointing at or away from the viewer).
